name: GET /api/estar-sections - FDA eSTAR sections
description: The eSTAR sections files are sorted into (AC1), as listed in Table 1 of FDA guidance "Electronic Submission Template for Medical Device 510(k) Submissions" (2023-10-02): id, FDA title and description, whether the section takes client evidence and whether it applies to Special 510(k)s only, with edition and source. Needs projects:read. Captures the id of Performance Testing (FDA ordinal 19, list index 18) for the assignment definition.
